alignment.primary: full-trajectory Umeyama Sim(3) on camera centres (evaluation only; reported scale/R/t)
alignment.secondary: Sim(3) fitted on the first 20 % (by time) of associated estimated frames, applied unchanged to the remaining frames (drift)
alignment.statement: neither alignment is estimation or online localisation; ATE after Sim(3) is not evidence of metric scale

controls.A: stationary best-constant-pose baseline (GT mean centre + chordal-mean GT rotation: most favourable to the baseline)

conventions:
W140 (EXPERIMENTAL, opt-in, scratch only): static-scene camera pose reconstruction -- pure numpy contracts and evaluation.

Isolated experimental camera-pose interface; NOT integrated into Production FramePose, MotionGraph, the S1 camera
calibration or any Blender root/spine/bone transform.

CONVENTIONS (frozen; never changed to improve a metric)
  * Camera optical frame "C" (OpenCV): +X right, +Y down, +Z forward (viewing direction).
  * T_WC(t) = [R_WC | c] maps camera-optical coordinates to world: X_W = R_WC X_C + c.  c is the CAMERA CENTER.
  * T_CW = T_WC^-1 = [R_CW | t_CW] with R_CW = R_WC^T, t_CW = -R_WC^T c (the "extrinsic translation" -- NOT the center).
  * Projection (OpenCV pixel convention: integer pixel coordinates are pixel CENTERS):
        x_C = R_CW X_W + t_CW;  u = fx x/z + cx,  v = fy y/z + cy.
    COLMAP uses a pixel-CORNER origin, so cx_colmap = cx_opencv + 0.5, cy_colmap = cy_opencv + 0.5.
  * Quaternions are stored SCALAR-LAST [qx, qy, qz, qw] (TUM order), unit norm, as rotation R_WC.
  * TUM groundtruth.txt "timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw" = optical-center position and orientation of the RGB camera in
    the motion-capture world frame, i.e. exactly T_WC in the TUM world (metres).
  * Blender camera local axes: +X right, +Y up, -Z viewing.  R_WC(optical) = R_W,blendercam @ diag(1, -1, -1).
  * Monocular estimates live in an ARBITRARY world gauge with ARBITRARY scale ("scale_status": SCALE_AMBIGUOUS).  Any
    comparison to GT uses an evaluation-only Sim(3) alignment that never feeds back into estimation.

Frame status categories: ESTIMATED, PREDICTED_INTERPOLATED, LOST, UNOBSERVABLE, INVALID.

estimator.config: SIFT max 8192 features; sequential pairing overlap 10 quadratic, no loop detection; single PINHOLE camera with the given intrinsics, NOT refined; mapper defaults incl. COLMAP's own init relaxation; random_seed 0; 8 threads; multiple models allowed; primary = largest model
estimator.determinism: random_seed 0 but multi-threaded mapping is not guaranteed bit-reproducible; exactly one run per dataset
inputs_only: RGB PNG frames (TUM: undistorted with the published fr1 parameters)
estimator.leak_guard: the runner refuses any input entry other than images/*.png, frames.json, camera.json, input_manifest.json
never_inputs: GT-derived initial poses, scale or alignment

status_semantics.INVALID: registered only in a secondary model (other gauge) or unreadable input

gates.classification: SUPPORTED: synthetic + xyz + rpy pass; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: some pass; NOT_YET_SUPPORTED: none; BLOCKED: a prerequisite fails. Pilot thresholds, not Production tolerances; never changed after results
gates.rpy: coverage >= 70% AND median aligned rotation error < 5.0 deg AND < the stationary baseline's

synthetic.contracts: oracle contract ok + focused tests pass
synthetic.recovery: aligned ATE RMSE <= 2% of GT extent, median rotation error <= 1.0 deg, coverage >= 90%, best time lag 0
synthetic.stationary: aligned max centre spread <= 1% of GT extent and max rotation spread <= 0.5 deg on frames [0, 19]

gates.xyz: coverage >= 70% (denominator = all 300 selected) AND Sim(3) ATE RMSE < 0.2 m AND ATE < the stationary baseline's

gt_association.gt_access: evaluate stage only, after estimate.json files are frozen by SHA-256
gt_association.rule: GT pose at each estimated frame's timestamp: linear position + SLERP rotation between the two bracketing GT samples, only if their gap <= 0.05 s; otherwise unassociated (reported); no index matching

metrics: RPE consecutive and ~1 s (translation scaled by the Sim(3) scale; rotation)
stationary baseline (Control A: best constant pose)
synthetic per-segment: stationary spurious motion, translation-interval rotation error, rotation-interval spurious translation

selection.missing_or_corrupt_rule: kept in the denominator as INVALID, never replaced
selection.rule: TUM: round(linspace(0, N-1, 300)) over rgb.txt order, chosen without GT or estimator output; synthetic: all 140 frames
